statement: Balanced fertilizer use requires appropriate timing and method; both overuse and underuse can reduce yield and cause economic or environmental loss.

statement: For Boro rice, apply P, K, S and Zn as basal during final land preparation; on light-textured soil split K between basal and the last N topdressing; split N into establishment, early tillering, and 5–7 days before panicle initiation.
title: Fertilizer Recommendation Guide-2024
section: 7.1 Cereal Crops — Boro rice, method of fertilizer application

required_farmer_context: soil fertility class or AEZ fallback
statement: For irrigated wheat, apply two-thirds of N and all P, K, S, Mg, Zn, B and organic manure as basal; apply the remaining one-third N 17–21 days after sowing after the first irrigation.
title: Fertilizer Recommendation Guide-2024
section: 7.1 Cereal Crops — Wheat, method of application

required_farmer_context: soil fertility class or AEZ fallback
statement: For Rabi maize, apply one-third of N and all P, K, S, Zn, B and organic manure at sowing; divide the remaining N between 50–55 days after sowing and tasselling at 80–85 days after sowing, side-dressed after irrigation.
title: Fertilizer Recommendation Guide-2024
